$comment: JSON schema definition for the Firestore shared incident state (blackboard) and 4-part message contract.
title: IncidentDocument
description: Firestore document stored under /incidents/{incident_id} representing reactive Blackboard shared state.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing incident (e.g., INC-0412 or INC-7F3A2B).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the incident across detection, root cause, repair, and verification.

status_reason.description: Detailed reason when status is escalated, dismissed, or error.

defect_type.description: Identified defect classification (e.g., scratch_vertical, short_fill, porosity).

defect_rate.description: Latest computed defective fraction across the sampling window.

spc_ucl.description: Statistical Process Control Upper Control Limit threshold.

suspect_machine.description: Machine identifier identified by Traceability and Process Analyst (e.g., CNC-02, IM-05).

suspect_tool.description: Cutting tool or mold cavity identifier (e.g., T07, MOLD-03).

root_cause.description: Confirmed root cause deduction from the 5-Whys and Ishikawa analysis.

verification_count.description: Current consecutive streak of defect-free parts passing optical inspection post-repair.

verification_target.description: Target streak required before incident can transition to closed status.

repair_done.description: Indicates physical technician intervention complete, gating entry to post-repair verification.

approved.description: Shift-leader sign-off recorded by the Orchestrator after verified closure.

findings.description: Ordered log of four-part contract findings emitted by specialized AI agents.

impact.description: Kaizen sustainability and economic impact metrics.

documents.description: Synthesized 8D report, maintenance work order, and updated SOP documents.

latest_telemetry.description: Latest sensor telemetry packet ingested from the physical edge.

telemetry_alerts.description: Rolling buffer of anomalous telemetry threshold breach events.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last incident state mutation.

AgentFinding.description: The authoritative four-part agent output contract: finding, evidence, confidence, citation.

agent_id.description: Canonical uppercase identifier of the emitting agent (e.g., QUALITY, TRACE, PROCESS, RCA).

agent_name.description: Human-readable display name of the agent.

phase.description: Investigation phase (e.g., Phase A - Detection, Phase B - Root Cause, Phase C - Resolution).

finding.description: Clear declarative conclusion deduced by the agent.

evidence.description: Quantifiable empirical data supporting the finding.

confidence.description: Statistical or model certainty score between 0.0 and 1.0.

citation.description: Verifiable reference source (BigQuery table, sensor window, SOP section, or camera buffer).

timestamp.description: Wall-clock time the finding was recorded.

ishikawa.description: 6M Ishikawa fishbone categorization breakdown (RCA agent only).
